summary.zh-Hans: 马若雷勒花园里有仙人掌、棕榈和竹子等植物。鲜明的马若雷勒蓝用于园中建筑，与植物的绿色形成对照。
summary.en: Jardin Majorelle contains plants including cacti, palms and bamboo. Its vivid Majorelle blue brings a strong contrast to the garden’s greenery.

summary.zh-Hans: 巴伊亚宫由一连串庭院、花园和厅室组成。装饰包括马赛克瓷砖、雕绘木作、灰泥和彩色玻璃等工艺。
summary.en: Bahia Palace is arranged as a succession of courtyards, gardens and rooms. Its decoration includes zellij tilework, carved and painted wood, stucco and stained glass.

summary.zh-Hans: 库斯库斯可用硬粒小麦粗粒制成，在摩洛哥可配肉类、鱼、鸡肉或蔬菜，也常配蔬菜汤汁。马拉喀什的餐馆供应这道菜。
summary.en: Couscous can be made from durum wheat semolina. In Morocco it is served with options such as meat, fish, chicken or vegetables, often with vegetable broth; it is also part of Marrakesh’s food scene.

summary.zh-Hans: 塔吉锅菜在马拉喀什有多种版本，食材可包括肉类、鸡肉、鱼或蔬菜，并配香料烹制；有些版本会加入坚果、李子或杏。
summary.en: Marrakesh serves several versions of tagine. Ingredients can include meat, chicken, fish or vegetables cooked with spices, with nuts, plums or apricots in some versions.
